messages:
kevin_ae: FYI customer wants a one-pager showing exactly how we verify domain control and how SCIM can be scoped to a claimed domain. Legal's worried about cross-domain user provisioning.

tara_ps: Short answer: DNS TXT or SAML-backed domain claim. They also want a dedupe/merge playbook for initial syncs.

li_dev: Implementation notes: we have two domain-claim flows:
1) DNS TXT: tenant creates TXT `_redwood-verify.<domain>` with token. We check DNS and mark domain as verified. Example record: `_redwood-verify.acme.com TXT "redwood=abc123"`.
2) SAML: IdP includes an `org` or `domain` attribute in the assertion and we verify IdP metadata + signing cert.

li_dev: SCIM scoping options:
- tenant-side filter: `GET /Users?filter=emails.value co "@acme.com"`
- server-side enforced scoping: admin sets allowed email domains in console; we reject provisioned users outside scopes.

kevin_ae: They asked whether we will auto-create users that show up in groups from other domains (e.g., contractor@partner.com).

sanjay_sec: We can disable "auto-provision from groups" per-tenant. Also we log `provision_source` on every user record and surface it in audit UI. Audit requirements we need to confirm: immutability window, retention period.

finance-bot: Note: Dedicated onboarding is a billed service (one-time setup + optional white-glove SRE support). Ongoing SCIM traffic doesn't incur per-user fees but heavy churn may push them into a higher reserved throughput bracket.

li_dev: For dedupe we recommend: 1) primary-key by externalId when provided, 2) heuristics on email + name with a manual merge UI, 3) dry-run mode for initial sync. We'll provide a merge-runbook.

kevin_ae: Can we give them a sample SAML metadata checklist?

li_dev: Minimal SAML checklist to ask IdP for:
- entityID
- SSO URL (POST/Redirect)
- x509 public cert (PEM)
- Attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups (name/ID)
- Optional: NameID format (email)

sanjay_sec: Security asks:
- TLS 1.2+ enforced for SCIM/SAML endpoints
- All SCIM writes encrypted at rest (KMS scope)
- Admin actions logged with actor, request-id and immutable append-only log
- Key rotation process for integration secrets (no permanent plaintext tokens).

li_dev: We can return header `X-Redwood-SCIM-Trace: scim-<ts>-<id>` on SCIM responses to help debugging. Also will add `initial_sync: dry-run` flag for bulk imports.

deploy-bot: poc-bot: POC workspace `acme-poc-2026` is live (eu-west). Console: https://poc.redwood.example/acme-poc-acme 
Endpoints:
- SCIM Base: https://scim.poc.redwood.example/acme
- SAML ACS: https://poc.redwood.example/saml/acs/acme

tara_ps: Customer requests deliverables: DNS TXT example, SAML checklist, SCIM scoping how-to, dedupe runbook, and ballpark Dedicated onboarding + 3-month support pricing. Deadline: EOD Monday.

kevin_ae: I'll compile the docs and finance numbers. @sanjay_sec can you confirm retention policy wording?

sanjay_sec: I'll confirm retention (default 365 days) and whether we can extend to 7 years for enterprise.

kevin_ae: Great. If we can bundle these and a short runbook demo into the POC console by Monday they are ready to sign the SOW. Thanks all.
